summary: Committed changes now reach your tenant in minutes instead of waiting for a full engine pass.

fixes.title: Only what changed runs
fixes.text: A committed change starts only the engine steps for the kind of data you changed, not every step for the whole tenant.

fixes.title: The engine starts right away
fixes.text: Commit and Run start the engine immediately, and a run in progress picks up new commits as soon as its current step finishes.

fixes.title: Smaller improvements
fixes.text: Faster admin and nesting checks, and every admin now shows a type on Admin accounts.
